attchmntText: Newspaper Advertisement   Un-audited Financial Results for the Quarter ended September30, 2026Pursuant to Regulation 47 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith copies of newspaper advertisement of Un-audited Financial Results for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026, published in Mumbai Lakshadeep and The Financial Express on November 01, 2026.

With the reference to the above captioned subject, we are enclosing here with the Standalone & Consolidated Un-audited Financial Result with the Limited Review Report on Financial Result of the Company for the quarter/half year ended September 30, 2026; pursuant to the regulation 33 of the SEBI (listing obligations and disclosures requirements) regulations, 2015 as received from Statutory Auditors of the Company M/s. JMMK & Co., Chartered Accountants, Mumbai.
Kanani Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
